verdict.rationale: Elicit documents an alerts feature that emails you when new relevant papers are found (elicit-docs-3, elicit-docs-15, elicit-docs-26), and long-running workflows like Systematic Reviews and Research Agent effort levels ('Smartest' mode) imply tasks that can take longer to complete (elicit-docs-2, elicit-docs-13, elicit-docs-22). However, alerts are for ongoing topic monitoring, not notification of a specific job's completion, and there's no evidence of a 'start and walk away, get notified when this specific job is done' async job model. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of background/async execution of a research job plus a completion notification (vs. topic-monitoring alerts), and any independent confirmation this works as described.
